basics.name: Pasquale Mangialavori
basics.label: Senior Frontend Engineer
basics.summary: Born in Tropea, in the south of Italy, and raised nearby in Capo Vaticano, I studied at La Sapienza in Rome and specialized with a master's degree at the University of Florence. After two internships, I started my career at Docomo Digital, then moved to Barcelona to work at eDreamsOdigeo. Since 2022 I've been building frontend platforms at Scandit.

work.name: Scandit
work.summary: Continuing to develop and maintain the Scandit Web SDK, delivering real-time web experiences built on the web platform.

work.name: Scandit
work.summary: Developed and maintained the Scandit Web SDK, delivering real-time web experiences built on the web platform.

work.name: eDreamsOdigeo
work.summary: On the design system team, built several primitive components in React and set up interaction and automated visual regression testing at the component level. Later moved to the accommodation team, putting those components into production on the results page for a new accommodation product.

work.name: eDreamsOdigeo
work.summary: Worked on the intermediate page, which offers hotels and other accommodation in the middle of the flight booking flow, across a legacy Backbone, JSP and Java codebase alongside newer React, TypeScript and GraphQL code. Rebuilt the flight summary component, built a small Storybook-style internal tool for previewing components in isolation, and mentored teammates.

work.name: luisaviaroma.com
work.summary: Designed and implemented the new React SSR architecture and developed the LVR-UI design system.

work.name: Docomo Digital
work.summary: Developed subscription-based web platforms for clients including Vodafone, TIM, Wind, and Sky — performant, spec-faithful frontend delivery.

work.name: Balzo
